comment: Covers the definition, IsPodAvailable, controller_utils, ReplicaSet, StatefulSet, DaemonSet, Job, Endpoints, PDB, Eviction (flagged as the internal-type version), HPA, and the other functions with the same name, so it hits nearly all the key points. Two small errors: it labels line 719 as ActivePods.Less when that line is in ByLogging.Less, and it gives test/e2e/framework/pod/wait.go:103 as a caller, but that file uses kubectl's podutils.

Covers controller_utils, ReplicaSet, StatefulSet, DaemonSet, Job, Endpoints, HPA and Eviction (correctly separated as the internal-type pkg/api/pod), with accurate line numbers. But it leaves out disruption.go:931, the PDB healthy-pod count that imports the function as apipod, and it calls replica_set.go:957/964 status calculation when those lines only feed a metric.

Accurate and specific: it correctly identifies ByLogging.Less (:719) as the one that prefers Ready pods, separates Eviction as the internal-type version, and covers Endpoints, HPA, workload status and requeueing. It still leaves out disruption.go:931 (the PDB currentHealthy count), and it gives IsPodAvailable as a building block rather than listing it as a caller.

Covers everything from K1 to K6, including IsPodAvailable, ByLogging, ActivePods and ActivePodsWithRanks, podReadyTime, nextPodAvailabilityCheck, every workload controller, Endpoints, disruption.go's countHealthyPods, Eviction as the internal-type version, and HPA. It also notes the other functions with the same name and the EndpointSlice implementation. The line numbers and function names it cites are all correct.

Hits nearly every key point: it correctly notes that disruption.go uses the alias apipod and that eviction.go calls a different function, and it correctly explains replica_set.go:957/964 as metric code. Its one slip is grouping lines 719–725, which are ByLogging.Less, under the 'not-ready pods are deleted first' sort, and it doesn't list IsPodAvailable as a caller.

Covers K1 to K6 and the other functions with the same name, and adds a correct point I verified: the kubelet itself never calls this function. Small weak spots: it lumps line 719 (ByLogging) in with the ActivePods sort, and it vaguely calls replica_set.go:957/964 'helper checks when choosing pods to delete' when they only feed a metric.
